log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Mirror match, same spreads. Bring Intimidate pivot + Scarf revenge + Mega sweeper. Lead Incineroar to Fake Out, break Multiscale, Parting Shot out. Scarf Gholdengo 223 eff outs Dragapult 213. Save Dragonite Mega late to DD sweep.
Plan: Fake Out and Parting Shot fail vs Gholdengo Ghost immunity. Stay and OHKO with Flare Blitz; survives one hit. Save Scarf Gholdengo to outspeed Dragapult, Mega Dragonite to sweep late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon team preview mismatch and Incineroar versus Gholdengo lead matchup.Evaluating Flare Blitz versus Darkest Lariat damage and Good as Gold blocking Parting Shot.Comparing Flare Blitz OHKO versus Darkest Lariat damage and switching risks against possible opponent Pokémon.

decisions.thought: Plan: Save low Incineroar for later Intimidate pivot. Foe Dragonite likely Earthquakes Incineroar. Switch to our full Multiscale Dragonite for immunity, then set up. Keep Scarf Gholdengo to outspeed Dragapult.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating battle state and legal moves to choose between attacking, pivoting, or switching.Assessing speed and KO risk to rule out Parting Shot and weigh sacrificing versus switching.Comparing Gholdengo and Dragonite switch-ins against Earthquake, Extremespeed, and Multiscale.Prioritizing Earthquake likelihood to favor Dragonite switch over Gholdengo for immunity.

decisions.thought: Plan: Ours 53% multiscale broken dies to another Claw, can't DD. Opp full multiscale. Switch Scarf Gholdengo resists Dragon, outspeeds 223 vs max 167, threaten with Steel/Ghost STAB. Save low Incineroar for late Intimidate pivot. Expect Dragon Claw.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon damage calculations and ability state to determine the optimal turn 3 move.Comparing identical team compositions and stat spreads to assess the multiscale advantage.Evaluating switch to Gholdengo for resistance and speed advantage versus Mega Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Plan: Scarf Gholdengo outspeeds Mega Dragonite. Use Shadowball to break Multiscale, avoid Make It Rain SpA drop lock. Save Dragonite for late, low Incineroar for Intimidate pivot. Expect Earthquake or Dragon Dance. Third foe unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Choice Scarf locking timing and speed advantage to select a damaging move against Multiscale Mega Dragonite.Comparing Make It Rain's higher first-hit damage against Shadowball's sustained damage without a SpA drop for the Choice Scarf lock.

decisions.thought: Plan: Force-send low Incineroar for Intimidate + Fake Out chip on Mega Dragonite, preserve 53% Dragonite with EQ immunity for late. Opp multiscale broken at 80%. Expect Dragon Claw/EQ next. Third foe unknown from Pult/Incin/Garg/Azu.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a Pokémon switch between Dragonite and Incineroar while accounting for speed, HP, and Mega Evolution constraints.Assessing immunity and damage interactions to confirm Dragonite as the safer switch.Comparing Dragonite and Incineroar switch options against predicted opponent moves and priority.Evaluating Fake Out priority and Parting Shot timing versus opponent attack and speed to preserve Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Plan: Fake Out flinches Mega Dragonite for free chip, survive this turn. Next hard-switch to Dragonite to take -1 hit, save 32HP Incineroar for later Intimidate. Opp multiscale broken ~80%. Expect Dragon Claw. Third foe unknown Pult/Incin/Garg/Azu.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Fake Out viability for Incineroar against weakened Mega Dragonite while weighing switch and damage tradeoffs.Assessing Fake Out priority and flinch to enable a safe Parting Shot pivot while accounting for KO risk.Evaluating switch timing and survival odds against a -1 Attack Mega Dragonite while preserving Incineroar for a later Intimidate pivot.Choosing Fake Out for free chip and flinch, then hard-switching to preserve Incineroar for a later Intimidate pivot.

decisions.thought: Plan: Switch Dragonite on predicted Earthquake immune or -1 Claw, save 32HP Incineroar for later Intimidate fodder. Opp Mega Dragonite -1 69% multiscale broken with Claw/EQ. Our Dragonite 53% broken. Third foe unknown Pult/Incin/Garg/Azu.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar's survival versus Mega Dragonite's moves and choosing Parting Shot to pivot safely.Assessing Parting Shot's priority and faint risk versus switching directly to Dragonite.Evaluating the sacrifice versus switch tradeoff for Incineroar given priority and faint risk.Assessing the free-switch immunity versus preserving low-HP fodder for the 2v2 endgame.

decisions.thought: Plan: Go for KO on -1 Mega Dragonite with Mega Claw; outspeed wins game. Our 53% Dragonite likely faster, Claw OHKOs 69%. Expect Dragon Claw back, ES too weak. Save 32HP Incineroar for Fake Out vs last foe Pult/Incin/Garg/Azu.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Dragonite's remaining HP and Multiscale status to choose turn 7.Calculating damage ranges for Dragon Claw versus Mega Dragonite and incoming retaliation.Comparing Dragon Claw and ExtremeSpeed tradeoffs against speed uncertainty and opponent HP.Evaluating Mega evolution to improve bulk against the opponent's likely -1 Dragon Claw.Comparing Mega Dragon Claw's high-variance KO chance against ExtremeSpeed's lower-variance chip damage.Evaluating speed tie odds and Mega bulk to choose between guaranteed chip and high-variance KO.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Plan: Last mon 32HP Incin vs -2 Mega Dragonite 69% plus unknown. Must Fake Out now for free flinch chip to survive. Next Parting Shot to -3 to live Claw/EQ, then Darkest Lariat chip. Both allies fainted, stall only hope.

decisions.thought: Plan: Last mon 32HP Incin vs -2 Mega Dragonite 60% plus one unknown. Cannot survive Claw/EQ, cannot KO. Maximize chip with Darkest Lariat over NVE Flare Blitz. Parting Shot deals none, still loses. Hope low roll.
